summary: scripts/st-test runs the upgrade-impact check (scripts/check-release-impact, from the merge's tree) on the merge of the head with the base before any wait and stops the run when the branch lacks a fresh release-notes/NAME.json; --status shows it as an upgrade-impact row

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: No evidence rule changes; CI's upgrade-impact job is unchanged and still decides.

compatibility.detail: A branch that lacks a release note now stops before st-test signs anything, where it used to sign and then fail upgrade-impact in CI. A base without scripts/check-release-impact is not asked.
